violations.description: Untrusted issue title used directly to select workflow runner hardware
violations.recommendation: Use static runner labels (e.g. ubuntu-latest) instead of dynamic event data for runs-on.

violations.description: Untrusted GitHub event data interpolated directly into shell script execution
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/script-injection.yml interpolates github.event.issue.title directly into a shell run command
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct expression interpolation in run blocks.

violations.description: Pull request/issue event workflow triggered with write permissions on contents
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/bypassable-actor-allowlist-gate.yml triggered on issue_comment has contents: write permission
violations.recommendation: Limit permissions to contents: read or remove unnecessary write permissions on untrusted event workflows.

violations.description: Workflow runs npm publish publish command without preceding build or test validation
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/bypassable-actor-allowlist-gate.yml executes npm publish --dry-run without build or test jobs
violations.recommendation: Ensure proper testing and build validation steps precede publishing or packaging steps.

violations.description: Untrusted pull request branch reference interpolated into download URL
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/filename-collision-download.yml interpolates github.event.pull_request.head.ref into a wget URL
violations.recommendation: Avoid interpolating pull request refs directly into command strings or URLs; validate or pass through environment variables safely.
